exact: FGF receptor signaling pathway involved in orbitofrontal cortex development
FGFR signaling pathway involved in orbitofrontal cortex development
fibroblast growth factor receptor signalling pathway involved in orbitofrontal cortex development

definition: The series of molecular signals generated as a consequence of a fibroblast growth factor-type receptor binding to one of its physiological ligands, which contributes to the progression of the orbitofrontal cortex over time from its initial formation until its mature state.
label: fibroblast growth factor receptor signaling pathway involved in orbitofrontal cortex development
